text: 2.2 1 I can't drink at the moment. I'm pregnant. Really? Congratulations! When is the baby due? 2 I am going to Canada to study English. Wow! That's great! How long are you going for? 3 I'm afraid I can't meet you tonight. Oh, what a shame. Are you sure? Four. My brother's not very well. Oh no, I'm really sorry. I hope it's not too serious. Five. I've lost my wallet. Oh no, what a pain. Did it have much in it? Six. I found my wallet. Phew! That's a relief! Where was it?
